task.title: Replacing a returned cheque with a cheque

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Returned payment for payment reference number [####-########].”
Details: Type “The payment for payment reference number [####-########] was returned. It has been replaced by cheque today.”

step.cmd: In SPS, select Returns & Duplicates in the Main Menu and Advice Notice Instructions in the Screen menu to issue a replacement payment as follows:

ul.li: Payment Reference Number: Enter the 12-digit payment reference number.
Address: Enter the client’s new address in capital letters.
Postal Code: Enter the client’s new postal code in capital letters.
Verify that the client’s name is correct. Click Submit .
Verify that the information entered is correct. Click Confirm .
